alerts.name: High CPU Usage - Warning
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el uso de CPU supera el 70% durante más de 5 minutos
alerts.query: SELECT avg(100 - (avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode='idle'}[5m]) * 100)) as cpu_usage FROM default WHERE cpu_usage > 70

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High CPU Usage Detected
notifications.message: El uso de CPU ha superado el 70%. Valor actual: {value}%

🟡 *HIGH CPU USAGE WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* CPU Usage
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 70%
*Duration:* 5 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Please investigate the cause of high CPU usage.

alerts.name: Critical CPU Usage
alerts.description: Alerta crítica cuando el uso de CPU supera el 90% durante más de 2 minutos
alerts.query: SELECT avg(100 - (avg_over_time(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode='idle'}[5m]) * 100)) as cpu_usage FROM default WHERE cpu_usage > 90

notifications.subject: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Critical CPU Usage Detected!
notifications.message: ⚠️ ALERTA CRÍTICA: El uso de CPU ha superado el 90%. Valor actual: {value}%. Acción inmediata requerida.

🔴 *CRITICAL CPU USAGE ALERT*

*Severity:* CRITICAL
*Metric:* CPU Usage
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 90%
*Duration:* 2 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

⚠️ *IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED*
The system CPU usage is critically high. Investigate immediately to prevent service degradation.

alerts.name: High Memory Usage - Warning
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el uso de memoria supera el 80% durante más de 5 minutos
alerts.query: SELECT avg((1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100) as memory_usage FROM default WHERE memory_usage > 80

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High Memory Usage Detected
notifications.message: El uso de memoria ha superado el 80%. Valor actual: {value}%

🟡 *HIGH MEMORY USAGE WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* Memory Usage
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 80%
*Duration:* 5 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Monitor memory usage and investigate potential memory leaks.

alerts.name: Critical Memory Usage
alerts.description: Alerta crítica cuando el uso de memoria supera el 90% durante más de 2 minutos
alerts.query: SELECT avg((1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100) as memory_usage FROM default WHERE memory_usage > 90

notifications.subject: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Critical Memory Usage Detected!
notifications.message: ⚠️ ALERTA CRÍTICA: El uso de memoria ha superado el 90%. Valor actual: {value}%. Acción inmediata requerida.

🔴 *CRITICAL MEMORY USAGE ALERT*

*Severity:* CRITICAL
*Metric:* Memory Usage
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 90%
*Duration:* 2 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

⚠️ *IMMEDIATE ACTION REQUIRED*
The system memory usage is critically high. Risk of OOM (Out of Memory) errors.

alerts.name: High Disk Usage
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el uso de disco supera el 85%
alerts.query: SELECT avg((1 - (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint='/'} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint='/'})) * 100) as disk_usage FROM default WHERE disk_usage > 85

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High Disk Usage Detected
notifications.message: El uso de disco ha superado el 85%. Valor actual: {value}%

🟡 *HIGH DISK USAGE WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* Disk Usage
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 85%
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Clean up disk space or increase storage capacity.

alerts.name: High Response Time
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el tiempo de respuesta supera 1000ms
alerts.query: SELECT histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket[5m])) * 1000 as response_time FROM default WHERE response_time > 1000

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High Response Time Detected
notifications.message: El tiempo de respuesta (P95) ha superado 1000ms. Valor actual: {value}ms

🟡 *HIGH RESPONSE TIME WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* Response Time (P95)
*Current Value:* {value}ms
*Threshold:* 1000ms
*Duration:* 3 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Application performance degradation detected. Check backend services.

alerts.name: High Error Rate
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la tasa de errores supera el 5%
alerts.query: SELECT (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~'5..'}[5m]) / rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m])) * 100 as error_rate FROM default WHERE error_rate > 5

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High Error Rate Detected
notifications.message: La tasa de errores HTTP 5xx ha superado el 5%. Valor actual: {value}%

🟡 *HIGH ERROR RATE WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* HTTP Error Rate (5xx)
*Current Value:* {value}%
*Threshold:* 5%
*Duration:* 3 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Multiple server errors detected. Check application logs and backend health.

alerts.name: Pipeline Build Failed
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el pipeline de Jenkins falla
alerts.query: SELECT increase(jenkins_job_failure_total[5m]) as failures FROM default WHERE failures > 0

notifications.subject: 🚨 [CRITICAL] Pipeline Build Failed!
notifications.message: El pipeline de Jenkins ha fallado. Número de fallos: {value}

🔴 *PIPELINE BUILD FAILED*

*Severity:* CRITICAL
*Metric:* Jenkins Build Status
*Failures:* {value}
*Time:* {timestamp}

⚠️ *ACTION REQUIRED*
The CI/CD pipeline has failed. Check Jenkins console output for details.

alerts.name: Pipeline Taking Too Long
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el pipeline tarda más de 10 minutos
alerts.query: SELECT jenkins_job_duration_seconds / 60 as duration_minutes FROM default WHERE duration_minutes > 10

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] Pipeline Taking Too Long
notifications.message: El pipeline está tardando más de 10 minutos. Duración actual: {value} minutos

🟡 *PIPELINE DURATION WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* Pipeline Duration
*Current Duration:* {value} minutes
*Threshold:* 10 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Pipeline is taking longer than expected. Check for performance issues.

alerts.name: High Pipeline Queue
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la cola del pipeline tiene más de 5 trabajos
alerts.query: SELECT jenkins_queue_size_value as queue_size FROM default WHERE queue_size > 5

notifications.subject: ⚠️ [WARNING] High Pipeline Queue Size
notifications.message: La cola del pipeline tiene más de 5 trabajos pendientes. Tamaño actual: {value}

🟡 *HIGH PIPELINE QUEUE WARNING*

*Severity:* Warning
*Metric:* Pipeline Queue Size
*Current Size:* {value} jobs
*Threshold:* 5 jobs
*Duration:* 5 minutes
*Time:* {timestamp}

*Action Required:* Pipeline queue is getting large. Consider adding more build agents.
